account:
Today has mostly followed my appointments: market walk, lunch at home, office accounts, and now tea with my neighbour at the east-bank cottage beside the ferry. I must return to the office for 16:30. The accounts review was incomplete: the secretary had no figures and did not know the ledger's location, and I found only 128 emeralds in the treasury, not a ledger. I do not know why the figures were unavailable.

The innkeeper requested a community gathering in the great hall tomorrow at 18:00. I approved it, and the secretary said it was recorded in the appointment book. The innkeeper also wanted a private conversation with the secretary about catering. That appears to concern preparing the gathering; I have no evidence of another purpose.

My neighbour has just mentioned an unusual but vague rumour about a bridge or port change heard near the bakery. They explicitly said there was no clear source and it should not be treated as news. I have seen no such change and heard no confirmed public announcement. I do not know who proposed it, whether anything is actually planned, or what it would be for. It is worth checking rather than passing along as fact.
